description: Runs a fixture-backed Web platform semantics probe for IndexedDB getAll() values vs getAllKeys() keys vs count() tally distinguished in one probe. The scripted CDP driver observes page output from the self-hosted fixture `/v2/idb/getall_keys_count`, and the server-side grader compares it against the Chrome-baked expected answer. The answer is computed only by executing the IndexedDB operation (it is not present in the static resource); the DB name is isolated per attempt via the `db` query param.
title: IndexedDB getAll / getAllKeys / count semantics
